results.1-2: Exausted (-1) Any Injury that lowers your overall stamina.
results.3-3: Exausted (-2) Any Injury that lowers your overall stamina.
results.4-5: Slowed Injured leg or foot, or any injury that lowers your overall speed.
results.6-6: Disoriented Injured head, or widespread injury that overwhelms your senses.
results.7-7: Surprised Overwhelmed due to the shock of an injury.

results.-5-0: Permanent Injury. The character suffers a permanent injury.
results.1-5: Vicious Injury. The character suffers a temporary injury with a duration of [[6d6]] days.
results.6-15: Shallow Injury. The character suffers a temporary injury with a duration of [[1d6]] days.
results.16-100: Flesh Wound. The character suffers a temporary injury for the remainder of the day.
